title: Signed line pullback unit presentation
statement: Given unit presentations (S,T,j,i) and (S′,T′,j′,i′) [def-pur-signed-line-pullback-unit-presentation], maps T→Z agree if they agree on j(x) for every source section. A source map a:S→S′ transports to i;L(a);i′^{-1}:T→T′ and sends j(x) to j′(a(x)). If L preserves finite products, presentations tensor to a presentation of the Cartesian product, whose comparison is (i×i′) followed by the inverse product comparison.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: Precompose two maps by the inverse presentation isomorphism. The inverse-image adjunction identifies equality with equality on unit sections, proving hom_ext. Transport source maps by conjugation and use unit naturality to prove map_unit. For products, use the inverse product comparison; test its unit equation against both projections.

proof_origin.place: Powers and duals, including unit, positive tensor recursion, evaluation, and unbounded derived action. The component proof is given below and in the attached Lean module.
